Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning street, road, highway, and Washington state ferries facility construction, maintenance, or repair activities conducted in accordance with best management practices of the Washington state department of transportation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to street, road, highway, and Washington stateferries facility construction, maintenance, or repair activitiesconducted in accordance with best management practices of theWashington state department of transportation; adding a new section tochapter 43.21C RCW; adding a new section to chapter 90.58 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 36.70A RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 47.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) New construction, or normal maintenance or repair activities,for streets, roads, highways, and Washington state ferries facilitiesare exempt from compliance with this chapter. (2) This section applies to new construction, or normal maintenanceor repair activities, for streets, roads, highways, and Washingtonstate ferries facilities conducted by or for counties, cities, or theWashington state department of transportation in accordance with bestmanagement practices required under section 4 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Guidelines adopted by the department and master programsdeveloped or amended by local governments under RCW 90.58.080 do notrequire modification of or limit new construction, or normalmaintenance or repair activities, for streets, roads, highways, andWashington state ferries facilities. (2) This section applies to new construction, or normal maintenanceor repair activities, for streets, roads, highways, and Washingtonstate ferries facilities conducted by or for counties, cities, or theWashington state department of transportation in accordance with bestmanagement practices required under section 4 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Comprehensive plans and development regulations do not requiremodification of or limit new construction, or normal maintenance orrepair activities, for streets, roads, highways, and Washington stateferries facilities. (2) This section applies to new construction, or normal maintenanceor repair activities, for streets, roads, highways, and Washingtonstate ferries facilities conducted by or for counties, cities, or theWashington state department of transportation in accordance with bestmanagement practices required under section 4 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Compliance with applicable environmental standards is presumed,unless site specific information demonstrates that new construction, ornormal maintenance or repair activities, for streets, roads, highways,and Washington state ferries facilities conducted by or for thedepartment causes or contributes to a violation of applicableenvironmental standards, when the department is fully implementingmaintenance or repair activity best management practices contained inmaintenance or repair activity manuals approved by the department andsubject to any required environmental review or practices that aredemonstrably equivalent to practices contained in maintenance or repair HB 2097 p. 2 activity manuals approved by the department and subject to any requiredenvironmental review.
